title: Deep Personalization: Continuous Context Observation for Local Proactive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.13457v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI agents become increasingly capable, users must still recognize when and how to ask for help, leaving many opportunities for useful support unrealized. Proactive agents hold the promise to close this gap, but effective proactivity requires understanding users' real-time activities and personalizing intervention timing so that assistance is offered when it is likely to be helpful rather than disruptive. We introduce deep personalization, a closed-loop process that connects continuous context observation with continual agent adaptation: an agent observes user activity, selectively retains long-term context, and adapts intervention decisions from implicit feedback. translated_title: 深度个性化：面向本地主动式智能体的持续上下文观察
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体的能力日益增强，用户仍然需要自行判断何时以及如何寻求帮助，这导致许多有价值的支持机会未能实现。主动式智能体有望弥合这一差距，但有效的主动性需要理解用户的实时活动并个性化干预时机，从而在帮助可能有益而非造成干扰时才提供协助。我们提出了“深度个性化”这一闭环过程，它将持续上下文观察与智能体的持续适应相连接：智能体观察用户活动，有选择地保留长期上下文，并根据隐式反馈调整干预决策。我们在Coco——一个主动式桌面智能体——中率先实现深度个性化，通过一个独立的观察者智能体来监控桌面活动、维护紧凑的长期用户建模上下文，并从参与度、忽略等隐式信号中学习何时提供帮助是合宜的。
tldr: 提出深度个性化闭环框架，通过独立的观察者智能体持续监控用户桌面活动、维护紧凑的长期用户上下文，并从隐式反馈中学习最佳干预时机，从而构建能够恰到好处地主动提供帮助的桌面智能体Coco。
en_tdlr: Introduces deep personalization, a closed-loop framework where a dedicated Observer Agent continuously monitors desktop activity, maintains compact long-term user context, and learns optimal intervention timing from implicit feedback in the proactive desktop agent Coco.
